verdict.rationale: Forter offers event-driven building blocks. Notification webhooks push real-time events to merchant systems or ERP/OMS. The commerce extension lets merchants configure decision handling, e.g. Auto Invoice captures payment and places the order on approval. The MCP server can update policies through natural-language commands. However, there is no evidence of a general user-defined rules engine for event-to-action automation; actions mostly have to be built by the merchant on top of webhooks. Missing for 10: a documented rule builder or policy engine for custom event-to-action triggers, details of what policy updates can express, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
